what: Proposed tier-4 mini-waterfall reuses ordinal 4 for three attempts, so later skipped or no-patch attempts overwrite earlier invalid-patch, apply-failed, or emit-plan-failed status.
scenario_or_breakage: Tiers 1-3 all return no-patch, tier-4 Codex emits an invalid file replacement, Cursor is absent, and Claude emits no patch; finalize sees only the last tier-4 status and reports failed-no-patch instead of failed-validation.
suggested_fix: Aggregate tier-4 statuses with precedence, or store per-tool tier-4 statuses and set REVISE_TIER_4_STATUS to ok if any attempt wins, otherwise the highest-priority failure before finalize.

what: Tier winner metadata still derives REVISE_PATCH_PATH from $winner-output.txt, but fallback attempts write to <tool>-fallback-output.txt.
scenario_or_breakage: Tier-4 Cursor succeeds after tier-2 Cursor failed; finalize emits REVISE_PATCH_PATH pointing at cursor-output.txt, so callers inspect the failed tier-2 output instead of the applied fallback replacement.
suggested_fix: Track winner_output_path from the output argument inside attempt_tier and emit that path in finalize.

what: The plan adds new revise artifacts such as prompt-unified-diff.txt and *-fallback-output.txt but does not update the strict plan-review artifact allowlist.
scenario_or_breakage: If publish sees these files before snapshot filtering, design-log-publish fails closed as unexpected plan-review files; if snapshot runs first, the new fallback forensic files are deleted and the winning fallback output is not preserved.
suggested_fix: Either use existing allowlisted artifact names or update scripts/lib-design-round-artifacts.sh, its md sibling, and tests to include the exact new fallback artifacts.
